findings.title: Unsubscribe does not mute users who are watching or tracking
findings.body: This branch changes every notification level above `regular` to `regular`, but both `tracking` and `watching` are above `regular` and still receive topic notifications. Consequently, following the email unsubscribe link does not stop notifications for users with either of those settings, despite the page promising that it will. Set the level to `muted` for the unsubscribe action rather than stepping down one level.

findings.title: The topic post-number route can capture unsubscribe URLs
findings.body: The `/t/:slug/:id` topic resource above defines a nested `fromParamsNear` route at `/:nearPost`, which has the same URL shape as `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe`. Because the topic resource is declared first, the client can recognize an unsubscribe link as a topic route with `nearPost` equal to `unsubscribe` instead of entering `topicUnsubscribe`. The email link then fails to show the unsubscribe screen; ensure the unsubscribe route takes precedence over the catch-all post-number route.
